Zoe (People Ops): Hi team, drafting a short Travel & Expense quick reference. Need final wording for per-diem, receipts, booking rules, advances, and spouse/guest policy. Keeping it snappy for the handbook.
Marcus (Sales): Are hotel caps the same for client-facing roles? Sometimes we need nicer rooms.
Priya (Finance): Guidelines: standard cap $275/night; high-cost metros (NYC, SF, LON) $350/night. Client-facing roles can request up to $300/night in most metros with manager pre-approval recorded in TravelPerk. Any exceedance requires pre-approval and a brief justification in the booking notes. No retroactive approvals.
Lin (Eng): Per-diem vs receipts: whats easiest for engineers on multi-day travel?
Priya (Finance): Two options for days with overnight stay: submit actual meal receipts OR elect the daily per-diem. Domestic per-diem (meals only) = $75/day. International per-diem = country rate from our appendix (enter country code in the expense form). If you pick per-diem for a day, you cannot also submit receipts for that same day. You may mix per-diem and receipts across different days of the same trip.
Marcus (Sales): Coffee/taxis under $25 do they need receipts?
Priya (Finance): Receipts required for any single expense >= $25. Expenses under $25: log as "misc" in the expense form with a short note; no receipt required unless the merchant issues one. If a merchant can't provide a receipt and the amount > $50, use the Missing Receipt Affidavit and get manager sign-off.
Zoe (People Ops): Travel advances and contractors? We had a contractor ask about cash advances for travel.
Priya (Finance): Contractors may request a Travel Advance via the Travel Advance form. Advances are reconciled within 15 business days of trip completion. Unspent amounts must be returned or will be deducted from final invoices. For advances > $1,000 Finance may require supporting estimates before approval.
Lin (Eng): Spouse/guest policy? A colleague wondered about partner dinner at a conference.
Priya (Finance): Default: spouse/guest expenses are NOT reimbursable. Exceptions only with pre-approval for documented business reasons (e.g., hosting a client). Approval must be obtained from manager + Finance in advance and the reimbursable business portion must be itemized.
Marcus (Sales): Conference fees and optional socials?
Priya (Finance): Conference registration fees are reimbursable with receipt and business purpose. Optional social events are not reimbursable unless pre-approved. If the organizer marks certain meals as mandatory for attendees, attach the schedule and we'll cover those.
TravelBot: Automated reminder: submit all expenses within 60 days of trip end date. Late submissions risk denial unless People Ops+Finance grant an exception. Link: https://redwood.example/internal/travel-policy
Zoe (People Ops): Thanks. I'll add a short checklist to the one-pager: 1) Book via TravelPerk when possible; 2) Use corporate card for flights/hotels where available; 3) Manager pre-approval for >cap or special cases; 4) Receipts for >=$25; 5) Per-diem $75 domestic or actual receipts; 6) Missing receipt affidavit >$50; 7) No spouse/guest reimbursement without pre-approval; 8) Submit within 60 days.
Marcus (Sales): Can we add expedite processing instructions? Sometimes reps need quick reimbursement.
Priya (Finance): Expedited reimbursements: tag "expedite" in the claim, include manager approval, and Finance will aim for a 2-3 business day turnaround. Standard processing follows our normal payroll cycle.
Lin (Eng): Any tips for multi-currency receipts uploads? The tool keeps splitting PDFs.
Priya (Finance): Tip: combine same-day receipts into a single PDF per category, include an expense line with original currency, converted amount, and exchange rate. For card charges we use the bank FX rate; for reimbursements use the tools conversion or XE on transaction date and attach proof if > $500 USD equivalent.
Zoe (People Ops): Final ask: can someone approve a tiny example JSON for devs who script uploads?
Priya (Finance): Sure, here's a minimal example you can paste in the handbook:```
{
  "date": "2026-06-15",
  "category": "hotel",
  "amount": "289.00",
  "currency": "USD",
  "merchant": "Parkside Hotel",
  "receipt_attached": "true",
  "manager_approval": "marcus@example.com",
  "notes": "client meetings - preapproved"
}
```
TravelBot: Note set: People Ops will publish the one-pager at 1764018000.
Zoe (People Ops): Perfect  I'll publish an FAQ and a short flowchart for pre-approval & missing receipts. Thanks everyone.
Marcus (Sales): LGTM.
Lin (Eng): Thanks, super clear.
Priya (Finance): I'll add the country per-diem annex and review the final draft.
